design_target.meaning: Requirement supplied by the design request; not an achieved waveform value.

theoretical_estimate.meaning: Closed-form modulation, output filter, DC-link and current-ripple sizing estimate.

waveform_prediction.meaning: Generated line-cycle and switching waveform summary, separate from sizing targets.

stress_and_feasibility.meaning: Electrical stress and feasibility derived from the candidate and waveform stages.

single_phase_full_bridge_inverter.boundary: TCM remains a staged first-pass mode and is not silently compared with CCM.

three_phase_two_level_voltage_source_inv.voltage_definition: line_line_rms_request and phase_neutral waveform are distinct
three_phase_two_level_voltage_source_inv.boundary: DC-link ripple remains a first-pass switching-ripple proxy.

three_phase_three_level_npc_inverter.device_roles: 12 active switch positions and 6 clamp diode positions
three_phase_three_level_npc_inverter.boundary: Neutral-point balancing and detailed parasitic validation remain explicit first-pass limits.
